```{r, Load and prepare data}

# Load in the data set including those who were later removed for post-treatment attrition 
df_preexclude <- read.csv("Voter_Reg_Pre_Exclude_Finished.csv")
nrow(df_preexclude) # 14189 (compared to 12927 in the full sample)

# Load in final data set
df <- read.csv("Voter_Reg_STRICT.csv")
nrow(df) # 12927

## Prepare variables ##

# Set reference level as the ControlCondition condition
df_preexclude$condition <- relevel(as.factor(df_preexclude$condition), ref = "ControlCondition")

# Make sure link click, register, and vote variables are factors for binary logistic regressions
df_preexclude$linkClicked <- as.factor(df_preexclude$linkClicked)
df_preexclude$register <- as.factor(df_preexclude$register)
df_preexclude$vote <- as.factor(df_preexclude$vote)

table(df_preexclude$linkClicked)
table(df_preexclude$register)
table(df_preexclude$vote)

```

########################################### Condition on Attrition

```{r, Attrition by condition and timing of dropout (crosstab)}

# Variable looking at before link-click page, after link click page, and completed survey and reached debrief 
df_preexclude$attrition_timing <- case_when(
  
  # Never reached the link-click page
  is.na(df_preexclude$linkClicked) ~ "Dropped before link-click page",
  
  # Reached the link-click page but then dropped later
  !is.na(df_preexclude$linkClicked) &
    df_preexclude$Finished == "False" ~ "Dropped after link-click page",
  
  # Finished survey / saw debrief
  df_preexclude$Finished == "True" ~ "Completed survey/debrief",
  
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

df_preexclude$attrition_timing <- factor(
  df_preexclude$attrition_timing,
  levels = c(
    "Dropped before link-click page",
    "Dropped after link-click page",
    "Completed survey/debrief"
  )
)

table(df_preexclude$attrition_timing, useNA = "always")

# Attrition percentage
attrition_perc <- df_preexclude %>%
  count(condition, attrition_timing) %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(percent = round(percent, 1)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = attrition_timing,
    values_from = percent,
    values_fill = 0
  )

attrition_perc

# Merge counts with percentage
attrition_pretty <- df_preexclude %>%
  count(condition, attrition_timing) %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    value = paste0(n, " (", sprintf("%.1f", percent), "\\%)")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(condition, attrition_timing, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = attrition_timing,
    values_from = value,
    values_fill = "0 (0.0\\%)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(condition = dplyr::recode(condition, !!!variable_labels)) %>%
  rename(Condition = condition)

attrition_pretty

attrition_xtable <- xtable(attrition_pretty,align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r"))

print.xtable(
  attrition_xtable,
  include.rownames = FALSE,
  sanitize.text.function = identity,
  sanitize.colnames.function = identity,
  floating = FALSE
)

```

```{r, Condition predicting whether Ps reached the first post-treatment outcome (link clicks)}

# Use linkClicked variable itself, since there is no item-level missing
# Timer is a good second option, but not ideal since does not collect data on people who reach a page but drop before advancing

table(df_preexclude$linkClicked, useNA = "always") # 611 NA, no item-level missingness
table(df$linkClicked, useNA = "always") # 0 NA

# attrition_1: 0 = dropped before first outcome; 1 = reached first outcome or later
# Variables after linkClicked, in survey order
later_vars_1 <- c(
  "reg_confirm", # All DVs after link click page
  "voteInt",
  "vote_today",
  "trust_exec", # Trust, efficacy, and norms in no particular order (randomized)
  "efficacy_1",
  "norms_1",
  "gender",
  "party"
)

# Attrition before first DV (link clicks): reached first outcome = 1, dropped out before reaching = 0
df_preexclude$attrition_1 <- ifelse(
  is.na(df_preexclude$linkClicked) &
    rowSums(!is.na(df_preexclude[, later_vars_1])) == 0,
  0, 1
) 

table(df_preexclude$attrition_1, useNA = "always")
# 611 drop out

# Check whether those coded 1 have values for linkClicked and later vars
View(df_preexclude[df_preexclude$attrition_1 == 1,
  c("attrition_1", "linkClicked", "voteInt", "vote_today", "trust_exec",
    "efficacy_1", "norms_1", "gender", "party", "Finished")
]) # Yes (good)

# Check whether those coded 0 are actually blank on linkClicked and later vars
View(df_preexclude[df_preexclude$attrition_1 == 0,
  c("attrition_1", "linkClicked", "voteInt", "vote_today", "trust_exec",
    "efficacy_1", "norms_1", "gender", "party", "Finished")
]) # Yes (good)

table(df_preexclude$attrition_1, useNA = "always") # 611 = 0, 13578 = 1

# Fit the model
Attrition_Model_1 <- lm(attrition_1 ~ condition, data = df_preexclude)
summary(Attrition_Model_1)

Attrition_Model_1_robust <- coeftest(Attrition_Model_1, vcov = vcovHC(Attrition_Model_1, type = "HC3"))
Attrition_Model_1_robust

# Use two tailed lm function to format
Attrition_Model_1_Results <- format_lm_output_twotailed(Attrition_Model_1_robust, Attrition_Model_1)

# Outputs:
Attrition_Model_1_Results$appendix   # Cleaned and formatted for LaTeX

print.xtable(Attrition_Model_1_Results$appendix_xtable, include.rownames = FALSE) # Syntax for latex editor

# Similar pattern to condition predicting Finished_n (below), indicating that
# differential attrition by condition is already demonstrated before the first DV

```

########################################### Intervention Features on Attrition

```{r, Predict attrition using condition features}

# Read in intervention text
Interventions <- read.xlsx("InterventionTEXT.xlsx")
view(Interventions) 

# Compute word count of each intervention
Interventions$word_count <- stringr::str_count(Interventions$text, "\\S+")

# Code whether there is a MC portion 
Interventions <- Interventions %>%
  mutate(mc = case_when(
    condition == "ControlCondition" ~ 0,
    condition == "CorrectingMisperceptions" ~ 0,
    condition == "DistrustSalience" ~ 0,
    condition == "DynamicNorms" ~ 0,
    condition == "EscalatingCommitment" ~ 4,
    condition == "ImplementationIntentions" ~ 0,
    condition == "InterdependentConstrual" ~ 0,
    condition == "MoralReasons" ~ 0,
    condition == "PersonalImportance" ~ 2,
    condition == "SelfGeneratedNorms" ~ 0,
    condition == "SystemJustification" ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_  
  ))
  
table(Interventions$mc, useNA = "always")


# Code whether there is an open-ended portion (count)
Interventions <- Interventions %>%
  mutate(openend = case_when(
    condition == "ControlCondition" ~ 0,
    condition == "CorrectingMisperceptions" ~ 0,
    condition == "DistrustSalience" ~ 0,
    condition == "DynamicNorms" ~ 0,
    condition == "EscalatingCommitment" ~ 2,
    condition == "ImplementationIntentions" ~ 4,
    condition == "InterdependentConstrual" ~ 0,
    condition == "MoralReasons" ~ 1,
    condition == "PersonalImportance" ~ 2,
    condition == "SelfGeneratedNorms" ~ 3,
    condition == "SystemJustification" ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_  
  ))

table(Interventions$openend, useNA = "always")


# Full length of timer per condition (in seconds)
Interventions <- Interventions %>%
  mutate(timer = case_when(
    condition == "ControlCondition" ~ 10,
    condition == "CorrectingMisperceptions" ~ 10,
    condition == "DistrustSalience" ~ 10,
    condition == "DynamicNorms" ~ 10,
    condition == "EscalatingCommitment" ~ 22,
    condition == "ImplementationIntentions" ~ 20,
    condition == "InterdependentConstrual" ~ 10,
    condition == "MoralReasons" ~ 60,
    condition == "PersonalImportance" ~ 32,
    condition == "SelfGeneratedNorms" ~ 11,
    condition == "SystemJustification" ~ 13,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_  
  ))

table(Interventions$timer, useNA = "always")


# Pages to advance 
Interventions <- Interventions %>%
  mutate(pages = case_when(
    condition == "ControlCondition" ~ 2,
    condition == "CorrectingMisperceptions" ~ 3,
    condition == "DistrustSalience" ~ 1,
    condition == "DynamicNorms" ~ 3,
    condition == "EscalatingCommitment" ~ 8,
    condition == "ImplementationIntentions" ~ 2,
    condition == "InterdependentConstrual" ~ 1,
    condition == "MoralReasons" ~ 2,
    condition == "PersonalImportance" ~ 9,
    condition == "SelfGeneratedNorms" ~ 3,
    condition == "SystemJustification" ~ 3,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_  
  ))

table(Interventions$pages, useNA = "always")

view(Interventions)

# Table of features
intervention_features_tbl <- Interventions %>%
  transmute(
    Condition = condition,
    `Words (Count)` = word_count,
    `Multiple Choice (Count)` = mc,
    `Open Ended (Count)` = openend,
    `Seconds` = timer,
    `Pages (Count)` = pages
  ) %>%
  arrange(Condition) 

View(intervention_features_tbl)

# Merge into full dataset (before attriters removed)
df_preexclude_intfeatures <- df_preexclude %>%
  left_join(Interventions, by = "condition") %>%
  dplyr::select(Finished_n, condition, word_count, mc, openend, timer, pages)

head(df_preexclude_intfeatures)

attrition_condition <- df_preexclude_intfeatures %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(
    completion_rate = mean(Finished_n, na.rm = TRUE),
    word_count = first(word_count),
    mc = first(mc),
    openend = first(openend),
    timer = first(timer),
    pages = first(pages),
    n = n()
  )

attrition_condition

attrition_condition_nocontrol <- attrition_condition %>%
  filter(condition != "ControlCondition")

# Correlations between features
attrition_condition_nocontrol %>%
  select(word_count, mc, openend, timer, pages) %>%
  cor() # Some highly correlated --> estimate in separate models

# Models predicting completion from features
AttritionPredictors_WordCount_Model <- lm(completion_rate ~ word_count,
   data = attrition_condition_nocontrol)
summary(AttritionPredictors_WordCount_Model) # NS

AttritionPredictors_MC_Model <- lm(completion_rate ~ mc,
   data = attrition_condition_nocontrol)
summary(AttritionPredictors_MC_Model) # NS

AttritionPredictors_OpenEnd_Model <- lm(completion_rate ~ openend,
   data = attrition_condition_nocontrol)
summary(AttritionPredictors_OpenEnd_Model) # Marginal

AttritionPredictors_Timer_Model <- lm(completion_rate ~ timer,
   data = attrition_condition_nocontrol)
summary(AttritionPredictors_Timer_Model) # Sig

AttritionPredictors_Pages_Model <- lm(completion_rate ~ pages,
   data = attrition_condition_nocontrol)
summary(AttritionPredictors_Pages_Model) # NS

# Table

# Combine condition-level models
attrition_feature_models <- list(
  "Words (Count)" = AttritionPredictors_WordCount_Model,
  "Multiple Choice (Count)" = AttritionPredictors_MC_Model,
  "Open Ended (Count)" = AttritionPredictors_OpenEnd_Model,
  "Seconds" = AttritionPredictors_Timer_Model,
  "Pages (Count)" = AttritionPredictors_Pages_Model
)

# Extract predictor coefficient from each model
attrition_features_results <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  attrition_feature_models,
  function(model, feature) {
    
    x <- summary(model)$coefficients[2, ]
    
    tibble(
      Variable = feature,
      b = x["Estimate"],
      SE = x["Std. Error"],
      t = x["t value"],
      p = x["Pr(>|t|)"]
    )
  }
)

attrition_features_results

attrition_features_results <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  attrition_feature_models,
  function(model, feature) {
    
    x <- summary(model)$coefficients[2, ]
    ci <- confint(model, level = .95)[2, ]
    
    tibble(
      Variable = feature,
      b = x["Estimate"],
      SE = x["Std. Error"],
      t = x["t value"],
      p = x["Pr(>|t|)"],
      `95% Lower` = ci[1],
      `95% Upper` = ci[2]
    )
  }
)

attrition_features_results

```

########################################### Baseline Political Interest by Condition on Attrition

```{r, Baseline interest*condition predicting attrition}

# Is the effect of condition on attrition moderated by political interest?

# Effects coded condition for omnibus effects
df_preexclude$cond_e <- factor(df_preexclude$condition)
contrasts(df_preexclude$cond_e) <- contr.sum(nlevels(df_preexclude$cond_e))

# Center interest
df_preexclude$interest_c <- df_preexclude$interest - (mean(df_preexclude$interest, na.rm = T))
mean(df_preexclude$interest_c, na.rm = T)

# Model
Attrition_Interest_Full_Omnibus <- lm(Finished_n ~ cond_e*interest_c, data = df_preexclude)
summary(Attrition_Interest_Full_Omnibus)

Attrition_Interest_Full_Omnibus_anova <- Anova(Attrition_Interest_Full_Omnibus, type = "III")
Attrition_Interest_Full_Omnibus_anova

# Format for LateX
Attrition_Interest_Full_Omnibus_anova_Results <- format_anova_type3_to_latex(Attrition_Interest_Full_Omnibus)

print.xtable(Attrition_Interest_Full_Omnibus_anova_Results$appendix_xtable, include.rownames = FALSE) # Syntax for latex editor

```

########################################### Primary Models After Excluding High Attrition Conditions

```{r, Identify high-attrition conditions}

# Based on completion of full study, so use Attrition_Model_2 (though results same when use Attrition_Model_1)

# Get predicted attrition values by condition
pred_df <- data.frame(condition = levels(df_preexclude$condition))

pred_df$predicted_completion <- predict(
  Attrition_Model_2,
  newdata = pred_df
)

pred_df

# Convert to attrition rates
pred_df <- pred_df %>%
  mutate(attrition = 1 - predicted_completion)

pred_df

control_attrition <- pred_df %>%
  filter(condition == "ControlCondition") %>%
  pull(attrition)

control_attrition 

# Conditions with attrition at or more than 25% higher than control
pred_df <- pred_df %>% mutate(high_attrition = attrition >= 1.25 * control_attrition)

pred_df

table(pred_df$high_attrition)

# Create df without EscalatingCommitment, ImplementationIntentions, MoralReasons, PersonalImportance, SelfGeneratedNorms, SystemJustification
df_no_high_attrition_conds <- df %>%
  filter(!condition %in% c("EscalatingCommitment", "ImplementationIntentions", "MoralReasons", 
                        "PersonalImportance", "SelfGeneratedNorms", "SystemJustification"))

# Drop conditions with n = 0
df_no_high_attrition_conds <- df_no_high_attrition_conds %>%
  mutate(condition = relevel(droplevels(factor(condition)), ref = "ControlCondition"))

table(df$condition)
table(df_no_high_attrition_conds$condition)

# % of sample lost
n_no_high_attrit <- nrow(df_no_high_attrition_conds) # 5983
n_final <- nrow(df) # 12927

pct_deleted <- round((1 - n_no_high_attrit / n_final) * 100, 2)
pct_deleted
# 53.72

```

```{r, Primary models after excluding high attrition conditions - voting intentions}

# Voting Intentions

# Fit the model 
NoHighAttritionConds_Intentions_Model_1 <- lm(voteInt ~ condition, data = df_no_high_attrition_conds)
summary(NoHighAttritionConds_Intentions_Model_1)

NoHighAttritionConds_Intentions_Model_1_robust <- coeftest(NoHighAttritionConds_Intentions_Model_1, vcov = vcovHC(NoHighAttritionConds_Intentions_Model_1, type = "HC3"))
NoHighAttritionConds_Intentions_Model_1_robust

# Use one tailed lm function to format
NoHighAttritionConds_Intentions_Model_1_Results <- format_lm_output_onetailed(NoHighAttritionConds_Intentions_Model_1_robust, NoHighAttritionConds_Intentions_Model_1)

# Outputs:
NoHighAttritionConds_Intentions_Model_1_robust
NoHighAttritionConds_Intentions_Model_1_Results$appendix   # Cleaned and formatted for LaTeX

print.xtable(NoHighAttritionConds_Intentions_Model_1_Results$appendix_xtable, include.rownames = FALSE) # Syntax for latex editor

#

# Joint F test voting intentions excluding high attrition conditions
linearHypothesis(
  NoHighAttritionConds_Intentions_Model_1,
  matchCoefs(NoHighAttritionConds_Intentions_Model_1, "condition"),
  vcov = vcovHC(NoHighAttritionConds_Intentions_Model_1, type = "HC3"),
  test = "F"
)

```

NoHighAttritionConds_TrustAgg_Model_1 <- lm(trust_agg ~ condition, data = df_no_high_attrition_conds) 
summary(NoHighAttritionConds_TrustAgg_Model_1)

NoHighAttritionConds_TrustAgg_Model_1_robust <- coeftest(NoHighAttritionConds_TrustAgg_Model_1, vcov = vcovHC(NoHighAttritionConds_TrustAgg_Model_1, type = "HC3"))
NoHighAttritionConds_TrustAgg_Model_1_robust

# Use one tailed lm function to format
NoHighAttritionConds_TrustAgg_Model_1_Results <- format_lm_output_twotailed(NoHighAttritionConds_TrustAgg_Model_1_robust, NoHighAttritionConds_TrustAgg_Model_1)

# Outputs:
NoHighAttritionConds_TrustAgg_Model_1_Results$appendix   # Cleaned and formatted for LaTeX

print.xtable(NoHighAttritionConds_TrustAgg_Model_1_Results$appendix_xtable, include.rownames = FALSE) # Syntax for latex editor

#

# Joint F test trust excluding high attrition conditions
linearHypothesis(
  NoHighAttritionConds_TrustAgg_Model_1,
  matchCoefs(NoHighAttritionConds_TrustAgg_Model_1, "condition"),
  vcov = vcovHC(NoHighAttritionConds_TrustAgg_Model_1, type = "HC3"),
  test = "F"
)

########################################### Lee Bounds Robustness Checks

```{r, Lee bounds - prepare data}

leebound_df <- read.csv('Voter_Reg_Lee_Bounds.csv') 
# Read in the data set that does not exclude people who dropped out AFTER being assigned into a condition

# Check to make sure each variable includes NAs for those who dropped out 
table(leebound_df$condition, useNA = "always") # Should not be any NAs here since everyone assigned a condition

# Vars with NO item-level missingness 
# 0s and 1s should match in both dfs. People who did not finish the survey should be NA

table(leebound_df$linkClicked, useNA = "always") # 1262 NAs
table(df$linkClicked, useNA = "always") # 0 NAs
 
table(leebound_df$register, useNA = "always") # 1262 NAs
table(df$register, useNA = "always") # 0 NAs

table(leebound_df$vote, useNA = "always") # 1262 NAs
table(df$vote, useNA = "always") # 0 NAs

# Vars with item-level missingness  
# Can be extra NAs here since some people finished survey but did not fill out this measure

table(leebound_df$voteInt, useNA = "always") # 1519 NAs
table(df$voteInt, useNA = "always")# 257 NAs

table(leebound_df$trust_agg, useNA = "always") # 1315 NAs
table(df$trust_agg, useNA = "always") # 53 NAs

table(leebound_df$efficacy, useNA = "always") # 1317 NAs
table(df$efficacy, useNA = "always") # 55 NAs

table(leebound_df$norms, useNA = "always") # 1319 NAs
table(df$norms, useNA = "always") # 57 NAs

# Check to make sure that all people who dropped have NAs for each outcome (should return 0s)
leebound_df %>%
  filter(Finished != "True" & !is.na(linkClicked))

leebound_df %>%
  filter(Finished != "True" & !is.na(register))

leebound_df %>%
  filter(Finished != "True" & !is.na(vote))

leebound_df %>%
  filter(Finished != "True" & !is.na(voteInt)) 

leebound_df %>%
  filter(Finished != "True" & !is.na(trust_agg)) 

leebound_df %>%
  filter(Finished != "True" & !is.na(efficacy)) 

leebound_df %>%
  filter(Finished != "True" & !is.na(norms)) 

# Table of completion rate per condition
leebound_df %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    completion_rate = mean(Finished == "True", na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

```

```{r, Calculate Lee bounded estimates for each DV}

# Set the control label
control <- "ControlCondition"

# List the treatment conditions (without the control)
treatments <- sort(setdiff(unique(leebound_df$condition), control))

# Set outcomes
outcomes <- c("voteInt", "linkClicked", "register", "vote", "trust_agg", "efficacy", "norms")

# Apply Lee Bounds function to each outcome and print
lee_results <- do.call(rbind,
  lapply(outcomes, function(out) {
    do.call(rbind,
      lapply(treatments, function(tr) {
        lee_bounds_simple(leebound_df, out, tr, control)
      })
    )
  })
)

lee_results

binary_outcomes <- c("linkClicked", "register", "vote")

lee_results <- lee_results %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(actual_estimate, lower_bound, upper_bound),
    ~ ifelse(outcome %in% binary_outcomes, . * 100, .)
  )) %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(actual_estimate, lower_bound, upper_bound),
    ~ sprintf("%.2f", .)
  ))

# Remove blank column
rownames(lee_results) <- NULL  # Drop additional column  

view(lee_results) # Paste into excel and then into Latex

# Note that Distrust Salience has very similar estimates for link clicks
# B/c retention rates are almost identical
leebound_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(condition %in% c("ControlCondition", "DistrustSalience")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    retention = mean(Finished == "True" & !is.na(linkClicked), na.rm = TRUE),
    n = dplyr::n()
  ) # Very similar

```
